title: johnsonia pubescens var. drummondii
intro: Johnsonia pubescens var. drummondii, commonly known as Drummond's Johnsonia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Xyridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Drummond's Johnsonia include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may contribute to its ability to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal properties.
